column3: The Hebrew repeats both sides in describing the cubit of excess and its hanging down.
The Hebrew names tachash skins rather than explicitly “fine leather.”
The Hebrew literally calls the tenons “hands.”
The Hebrew doubles the southern direction: “the south side, southward.”
The Hebrew repeats two bases under each frame for its two tenons.
The Hebrew repeats “two bases under one frame” for a second frame.
The Hebrew repeats the arrangement of two bases for each of two frames.
